name: Translator
short_desc: Translate Thai, English and more privately on your own box
author: Humanity Labs
description: Private translation between Thai, English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Spanish, French, German and Russian, powered by a self-hosted LibreTranslate engine (AGPL-3.0). About 2.2 GB of language models download on first start; the engine uses about 1 GB of RAM.
